title: Zebrafish (Danio rerio) length-at-age, laboratory standard, for side-by-side comparison with the flying fish
not_a_mechanistic_model: Data-driven: staging tables, measured growth rates and a published von Bertalanffy fit. Nothing simulates development.
conditions: Every zebrafish source here was reared at lab temperatures (28.5 C Parichy 2009; 28 C Lalonde 2018; 27.1 +/- 2.0 C Beaudouin 2015; 28.5 C implied by the ZFIN/Kimmel hpf series). This differs from the project baseline of 25 C (conditions/baseline.json). Per the project rule it is recorded as metadata and NOT corrected for. Parichy 2009 shows temperature changes growth rate (24 C: 0.45, 33 C: 0.54 mm SL/day) but leaves size-at-stage almost unchanged.
age_axis: days post-fertilisation (dpf) inside this file; trajectory.mjs also exposes days post-hatching to match the flying fish

segments.relation: no SL; stage from hpf (ZFIN stage ontology = Kimmel 1995 series)

value.locator: Larvae page, "Length at birth (mm) 3.1", Ref 58952; Main Ref Kimmel et al. 1995; "Hatching occurs 48 h after fertilization"

cross_check.locator: "hatching most commonly occurs between 48 and 72 h post-fertilization, when fish are about 3.1–3.5 mm in length (Kimmel et al. 1995)"

value.locator: "Pec-fin stage (3.4 mm SL onset)", Fig. 32; "begins ~60 hpf at 28.5 °C"

rate.locator: "individually reared larvae that were repeatedly anesthetized grew slowly (SL mm per day mean±SE: 0.32±0.004; Fig. 3)"

segments.why_0.32: it is the only rate measured on the same individuals followed through all milestones (longitudinal dataset), and it reproduces Parichy's statement that "the juvenile period lasts from ~4 weeks post-fertilization": 3.4 mm at 2.5 dpf + 0.32 mm/d reaches 11.0 mm (stage J) at 26.3 dpf. The group rates (0.45-0.55) would put J at 16-19 dpf.
segments.kind: measured rate; linear form assumed (Parichy reports a mean rate, not a curve)

segments.relation: SL_mm = 45.1 * (1 - exp(-3.97/365 * (dpf - t0_d))), t0_d chosen so that SL = 11.0 mm at 26.3 dpf (continuity)

Linf.locator: growth detail autoctr 4255: "L infinity (cm) : 4.51 SL", Locality "Laboratory (aquaria with unlimited food - Paramecium)", Main Ref 312 = Pauly 1978 (compilation), Data Ref 879; non-linear regression; captive; temperature not given

t0.locator: no t0 given on FishBase; set so the curve passes through stage J

segments.note: At the join the VB slope is 3.97/365 x (45.1 - 11.0) = 0.37 mm/day, close to the 0.32 mm/day larval rate, so the two pieces meet smoothly.
